# `prefer-try`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: fix all · Options: none

Reports a caught error that is immediately returned unchanged.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

`try` states direct propagation concisely and avoids an unnecessary capture and
catch expression.

## When it fires

It applies when the enclosing function can return the error and the catch
performs no additional work.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn run() !void {}

fn f() !void {
    run() catch |err| return err;
}
```

Reference: <https://ziglang.org/documentation/master/#Errors>
